senses.gloss: m. (שקט, Shaf. of קט; cmp. קטט, קוט) [cut short,]

units: <cite ref="Nedarim 66b:6">Ned. 66ᵇ</cite> <he>שמא … ש׳ הוא</he> is her neck graceful? It is too short.

<cite ref="Tosefta Bekhorot 5:1">Tosef. Bekh. V, 1</cite> <he>צוארו שמוט וש׳</he> whose neck is abnormally long or abnormally short; <cite ref="Bekhorot 43b:4">Bekh. 43ᵇ</cite>, expl. <he>דחביא מיחבא</he>, v. <cite ref="H00048"><he>חֲבֵי</he></cite>; v. <cite ref="U01430"><he>שָׁמוּט</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: abruptly bent, angular. Ib. VII, 1 (43ᵃ) שראשו ש׳ (Mish. ed. שקוע) he whose head is angular, expl. ib.ᵇ ש׳ מלפניו shaḳuṭ refers to the front of the head (the forehead receding abruptly).
